hypothesis: Round 8 C4 baseline is reproducible from the frozen v4 corpus
experiment: rerun r8_run_parity_v5.py with market_fundtest2.db on the same manifest/ref/product files
result: exact reproduction: 50.8008 exact, 86.8274 near, 51.6810 functional, REF_ONLY 138, PROD_ONLY 139, pairs 6378, mismatch 217
decision: baseline is reproducible as a harness measurement; verify whether it is the production path

hypothesis: C4 harness metrics equal the production chart path
experiment: stream product records and compute factors via api.chart._canonical_adjustment on the pre-backfill isolated DB (r9_prod_parity_fast.py)
result: production path is much lower: 38.9343 exact, 79.802 near, 39.5054 functional on 2,595 assets; C4 harness did not add official DB events, only re-rated existing product events
decision: Round 8 headline was a harness measurement; use production-path baseline for Round 9 and document the reconciliation

hypothesis: Official CODAL AGM/rights notices are accessible and can supply pre-2024 DPS and subscription price S
experiment: query search.codal.ir/api/search/v2/q with Jalali dates; fetch Decision.aspx letters; parse DividendPerShare and subscription text
result: accessible. حخزر DPS 6300 (1401) and 2170 (1402); سپاها 2395/1380; حخزر rights notice: S=1000 rials, capital 1.08T->3.6T, 30,386,341 shares. Rate limit 429 after two symbols; no captcha bypass
decision: use CODAL for confirmed DPS/S; treat other symbols as BLOCKED_RATE_LIMIT; do not bypass

hypothesis: TSETMC price-adjust flow has full history, not only 2024+
experiment: query GetPriceAdjustByFlow 1..4 with size 9999; compare with the 1,005 DB rows
result: 12,894 rows from 2008-11 to 2026-10; حخزر flow 2 has the 2023-06-21 row (pNA 54,850, pC 48,550, DPS 6,300). DB only had 1,005 rows from 2024-07
decision: classify rows by official share changes; backfill only confirmed DPS first

hypothesis: Pre-2024 DPS can be filled by matching marks-typed DPS to official flow amounts
experiment: match flow rows to timescale_marks DPS/CC within 30 days, insert only DPS with amount within 1% of marks (7 symbols)
result: 52 DPS rows inserted; 40+ historical events including حخزر 6300, سپاها 1770, كلوند 1870/2650; پخش 2023 rejected (flow 758 vs marks 1200) and documented
decision: measure the backfill; do not hide the mixed result

hypothesis: The production double-counts a DPS and a capital event when the base gap already contains both
experiment: add combined-event hypothesis test: base_gap vs share_change vs DPS*share; suppress the separate DPS when the combined hypothesis is closer
result: حخزر 2026-07-26 fixed; per-symbol production near 3.9% -> 100% in r9_patch_7sym; بورس 2026-07-26 remains two distinct events (CC-only)
decision: keep the combined-event rule; add tests for combined and CC-only cases

hypothesis: Same-action official rows can differ by more than 0.1% because they use different base prices
experiment: widen same-action tolerance to 2%; test شسپا 2026 (0.873257 vs 0.886040) and دانيك/پالایش
result: شسپا near 4.6% -> 72.6% in the per-symbol production run; دانيك/پالایش duplicate suppressed; 38/38 DPS tests pass

hypothesis: A base gap and an official DPS are the same action even when separated by a suspension
experiment: normalize every event date to the first candle on/after it before merging; test 2023-06-24 -> 2023-07-08
result: حخزر suspension duplicate merged; test 3 cases pass; production path still shows separate C4/model gaps
decision: keep effective-date normalization; remeasure production full universe

hypothesis: The 52 DPS rows improve the production full universe
experiment: run r9_prod_parity_fast.py on market_r9_base.db vs market_fundtest2.db with the same code, 2,595 assets
decision: mixed: shape improves, absolute exact/near slightly worse; keep backfill in isolated DB only, do not claim aggregate improvement

hypothesis: The chart basis and scale can be verified without the owner login
experiment: add an isolated Vitest suite for the four combinations using the mocked KLineCharts engine
result: 5/5 pass: combined/raw x linear/log give the expected series and axis name; volume/timestamps unchanged; interactive pixel behavior remains LIVE_UI_UNVERIFIED
